entities.name: Kalemnos
entities.description: A triton of Theros who became one of the first of Kiora's Followers.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: Planeswalker who first planeswalked to Theros and posed as Thassa's emissary to the tritons.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: Sea goddess whom Kalemnos believed Kiora served.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God whose speaking led the gods to retreat into Nyx.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: The absence of the gods after Kruphix spoke and they retreated into Nyx.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Realm into which the gods retreated.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: Human polis near which Kiora met the tritons.

entities.name: Siren Sea
entities.description: Sea where Kiora encountered the tritons.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The mortal world where the story takes place.

events.summary: Kiora first planeswalks to Theros and encounters a group of tritons including Kalemnos, who tell her where she is.
events.quote: After Kiora first planeswalked to Theros , she encountered a group of local tritons

events.summary: Kalemnos explains the Silence of the Gods.
Kalemnos takes Kiora for Thassa's emissary; Kiora plays along, claiming Thassa set a quest to gather the sea creatures, and the tritons follow.
events.quote: Kalemnos believed Kiora to be an emissary of Thassa

relations.quote: became one of the first of Kiora's Followers on Theros
sent to guide them while the goddess herself was absent
